'''San Miguel Creole''' (otherwise known as '''Panamanian French Creole/Patua''') is a dialect of [[Antillean Creole|Lesser Antillean French Creole]] spoken by the descendants of [[Saint Lucia|St Lucians]] and [[Martinique|Martiniquais]] who emigrated to [[Panama]] (specifically the town of [[San Miguel, Panamá Province|San Miguel]] and [[Colón, Panama|Colon]]) in the 19th century. They came over as construction workers on the [[Panama Canal]]. There is very little information on the language and therefore it is likely an extinct language in Panama (although some sources claim that there are a few who speak the language, mainly older people in the city of Colon: Lee, writing in 2017, stated there were 3 speakers,<ref name="lee">{{cite journal |last1=Lee |first1=Nala |title=Contact languages around the world and their levels of endangerment |journal=Language Documentation and Conservation |date=2018 |volume=12 |pages=53–79 |url=https://scholarspace.manoa.hawaii.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/d034193a-7c16-4d14-98d3-79c4b36631c8/content}}</ref> Snow, writing in 2005, said it was "nearly extinct"<ref>{{cite book |last1=Snow |first1=peter |editor1-last=Mühleisen |editor1-first=Susanne |editor2-last=Migge |editor2-first=Bettina |title=Politeness and Face in Caribbean Creoles |date=2005 |publisher=John Benjamins |location=Amsterdam/Philadelphia |page=40 |chapter=The use of "bad" language as a politeness strategy in a Panamanian Creole village}}</ref>). There probably are remnants in local elder communities of the language, probably words and phrases, however the language is considered lost and extinct by most, with no sources on the vocabulary (although it can be reconstructed using its parent language [[Saint Lucian Creole]]).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Glottolog 5.2 - San Miguel Creole French |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/sanm1305 |access-date=2025-09-14 |website=glottolog.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=San Miguel French Creole Language (SCF) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use {{!}} Ethnologue Free |url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/scf/ |access-date=2025-09-14 |website=Ethnologue (Free All) |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Charter |first=Click and Sailing {{!}} Panamá Boat |date=2025-03-26 |title=What Language Is Spoken in Panama? A Complete Local Guide (2025) |url=https://www.clickandsailing.com/en/post/what-language-is-spoken-in-panama |access-date=2025-09-14 |website=Clickandsailing |language=en}}</ref>
